info.name: BrandFlow Enterprise Platform — Master API Suite
info.description: Comprehensive production API collection for BrandFlow Platform. Includes full test suites for Auth, Google OAuth, 2FA, SubAdmin RBAC, User Directory, Business Categories, Design Styles, BrandKit, Transparent PNG Frame Blueprints, Graphic Base Templates, User Composited Posts, Social Media Queue & Publishing, Content Calendar Festivals, Graphic Vault, and Social Integrations.

request.description: Checks server health, uptime, and database connectivity.

request.description: Authenticates user credentials. If 2FA is enabled, returns require2FA: true and mfaToken.
Authenticates user using Google One-Tap / OAuth ID Token.
Sends password reset instructions to user's registered email.
Resets user password using reset token.
Verifies 6-digit TOTP code or recovery code during 2FA login challenge.
Rotates refresh token and returns a new Access Token using HTTP-Only cookie.
Revokes refresh token in database and clears HTTP-Only refresh cookie.
Fetches currently logged-in user profile, role flags, and 2FA status.
Generates TOTP secret and QR code Data URL for authenticator setup.
Confirms TOTP code, enables 2FA, and returns single-use backup recovery codes.
Disables 2FA security on authenticated account.
Creates a new SubAdmin account with assigned allowedTabs permissions (SuperAdmin only).
Fetches paginated list of all created SubAdmins and permissions (SuperAdmin only).
Updates allowedTabs permissions for an existing SubAdmin (SuperAdmin only).
Deletes a SubAdmin account by ID (SuperAdmin only).
Fetches paginated directory of registered users (Admin / SuperAdmin only).
Fetches the authenticated user's active BrandKit profile.

request.description: Publishes a new transparent PNG frame overlay (strictly stored in Cloudinary 'brandflow/frames/overlays' for overlayPngUrl and 'brandflow/frames/previews' for previewUrl).
Deletes a transparent PNG overlay frame by ID and cleans up images from Cloudinary storage.
Fetches predefined graphic template categories.
Fetches paginated festival and marketing graphic base templates.
Uploads a base festival/marketing graphic background strictly to Cloudinary 'brandflow/festival-templates' and saves to database.
Creates a master system graphic template with a direct image URL or base64.
Deletes a graphic base template by ID and cleans up associated image from Cloudinary storage.
Fetches all composited posts created by the authenticated user.
Fetches the scheduled posts queue for the authenticated user.
Instantly publishes a composited graphic post across connected social media platforms.
Schedules a composited post for automatic social media publishing at a future date & time.
Manually triggers the background cron dispatcher cycle to process due scheduled posts.
Saves a composited 1080x1080 post image strictly to Cloudinary 'brandflow/posts', database, and Vault.
Deletes a composited post by ID and cleans up associated image from Cloudinary storage.
Fetches all upcoming national and regional festival calendar events.
